rules.title: Metric Net Quantity Declaration
rules.name: Metric-Only Net Quantity Declaration
rules.sourceQuote: The net quantity shall be stated in terms of standard units of weight or measure using metric units (g, kg, ml, l). The declaration shall not be accompanied by any qualifying words.
rules.description: Net quantity must be declared in metric units (g/kg). Primary US customary units (ounces) are strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP incl. of all taxes)
rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP incl. of all taxes)
rules.sourceQuote: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, with the declaration: 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs. or ₹ .... (inclusive of all taxes)'
rules.description: Mandatory MRP declaration in Indian Rupees inclusive of all taxes (e.g. MRP ₹ 450.00 incl. of all taxes).

rules.title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
rules.name: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021, Rule 6(1)(m)
rules.sourceQuote: The unit sale price shall be declared on the package, in the case of packages containing commodity more than one kilogram or one litre, per kilogram or per litre, and if less than one kilogram or one litre, per gram or per 100 gram or per millilitre.
rules.description: Mandatory unit sale price (e.g. 'Unit Sale Price: ₹ 0.94 / g' or '₹ 93.75 / 100g') adjacent to MRP declaration.

rules.title: Consumer Care Contact Details
rules.name: Consumer Care / Grievance Redressal Contact
rules.sourceQuote: The name, address, telephone number, email address of the person who can be contacted by the consumer, in case of consumer complaints, shall be declared on the package.
rules.description: Contact details of consumer grievance officer including name/designation, address, phone number, and email.

rules.title: Country of Origin Declaration
rules.name: Country of Origin Declaration
rules.sourceQuote: In the case of packages containing imported goods, the name and address of the importer and the name of the country of origin or manufacture shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.description: Country of origin or manufacture (e.g. 'Country of Origin: USA') and importer details must be declared on imported goods.
